text: West Texas Intermediate rose to $90.14 per barrel and Brent reached $92.32. Tanker movement through the Strait of Hormuz approached a standstill amid expanding regional conflict. U.S. crude gained nearly 35% during the same week.

meta.note: Price threshold crossing and shipping disruption logged within the same market snapshot.

text: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported nonfarm payrolls declined by 92,000 in February while the unemployment rate rose to 4.4%. Job losses occurred in health care, manufacturing, information services, transportation, construction, and federal government employment. Average unemployment duration increased to 25.7 weeks.

meta.note: Strike and weather referenced in report but excluded from structural classification.

text: The president publicly stated that no agreement would end the war with Iran without unconditional surrender. U.S. equity indices declined following the statement, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average falling more than 900 points and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq each dropping about 1.6%.

meta.note: Statement and immediate market repricing occur within the same disclosure window.
